title: Mursilis I sacks Babylon; end of the First Dynasty of Babylon
summary: CFAH-13 (OSF preprint) AP-82: the sack of Babylon by Mursilis I ended the First Dynasty of Babylon, 851 BC.
description: CFAH-13 (OSF preprint) AP-82: the sack of Babylon by Mursilis I ended the First Dynasty of Babylon, 851 BC.

sorting_basis.note: Tier 1: CFAH anchor point: 851 BC (AP-82, OSF preprint CFAH-13)

chronologies.citation: Griffith & White, "CFAH-13: The Hittites, Cimmerians, and Medes," OSF preprint v1.3 (2026), doi:10.17605/OSF.IO/BCWG2, file CFAH-13_Hittites_Cimmerians_Medes_v1.3.pdf, p. 31
chronologies.note: CFAH-13 p. 31: "establishes Anchor Point #82, Sack of Babylon by Mursilis ends the First Dynasty of Babylon, 851 BC." OSF preprint, not peer-reviewed in ARJ; see docs/OPEN-QUESTIONS-FOR-KEVIN.md on whether preprint anchor points should set tier 1.
Jones (Chart No. 1; Chronology of the Old Testament, 2002) gives no date for this extra-biblical event.
No matching entry found in Ussher's Annals.

chronologies.citation: Preparing the World for Jesus (2nd ed., 2024), ch. 14 "Old Babylon–The Rising Threats to Israel", PDF p. 352 (printed p. 338)
chronologies.note: The dynasty ends 282 years on, with the death of Samsu-ditana.
